violations.description: Written safety plan is available with established policies and procedures for safe operation including fire safety health care plan corrective action plans staff training and emergency evacuation plan. Plan reviewed annually and updated as needed.

School-based child care staff observed caring for children while unhealthy. Staff medical certificate of fitness Not provided.
